resources.string: Tips are off. Turn them back on in More › Today screen.
Tap a number with the arrows to see it another way, like eaten or still to go.
Tap a food you logged to see what's in it or change the amount.
Pull down on Today to check for anything new from your other devices or your health app.
Your weight goal sets this target. Tap here to change the goal.
Every first-run tip can show again on this phone, for this account.
